title: Precision BioSciences
summary: US gene-editing company developing ARCUS nuclease therapies.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Precision BioSciences develops gene-editing therapies using its ARCUS nuclease, with programmes in oncology, rare disease and in-vivo editing. It licenses the platform to partners and has narrowed its own pipeline to conserve cash. Clinical milestones and partnering are the value drivers.

Technology Exposure

  • ARCUS gene editing
  • Allogeneic cell therapies
  • In-vivo gene editing

What To Watch

  • Clinical data
  • Partnering
  • Financing

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
